name.description: Optional name locally unique to the parent {@link FlowGraph}. Useful for user-facing APIs such as visualization.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

parents.description:
ids of parent vertices in {@Workflow#parent} {@link FlowGraph}. NOTE: there can be multiple in the case
that several vertices in the parent {@link FlowGraph} were merged as part of translation to a single vertex
in the new graph.

timeout.description:
Timeout for the execution of the vertex. After timeout time has passed the vertex execution fails if not
successfully completed or failed already.

options.description: Options to run the MapReduce job with.

handlerType.description:
Handler for customizing how to start the {@link job}.
If unspecified, then {@link JobBase#start} of {@link #job} will be used.

title:
A specialized {@link Workflow.Vertex} that represents a {@link MapReduce} job.
Every {@link Workflow.MapReduce} has two input ports: a port "options" and a port "$start". The "options" input, if connected,
will override the options provided in the {@link #options} field.
Every {@link Workflow.MapReduce} has two output ports: "$success" and "error". NOTE: this vertex type has no other output.
See {@link Workflow} for more details on ports "$start", "$success", and "error".
```
-------------------                         -----------------------
| Workflow.Action | $success ---> $start    |                     |
-------------------                         |                     | $success -----------> ...
                                            |  Workflow.MapReduce |
-------------------                         |                     | error --------------> ...
| Workflow.Action | out --------> options   |                     |
-------------------                         -----------------------
```
name: Workflow.MapReduce
